content:
rahul: Heads up — yesterday's route-cost signal change (sending price_hint on requests) landed in proxy canary. Noticed small invoice preview deltas in staging :thinking_face:

jen: saw it in the dashboard too, ~2.8% variance on a couple of tenants. Could be expected, but want to make sure we're not double-counting when enrichers attach price_hint -> invoice events.

taylor: quick q — is price_hint only metadata for routing decisions or persisted into billing events?

rahul: it's intended as a routing/cost-signal only. The plan was: proxy emits X-Route-PriceHint in request headers, routing service uses it to pick cheaper compatible model, but metering should ignore it unless explicitly mapped to invoice.surcharge.

eoin: reality: our ingest-side enricher is currently copying all request headers into event.metadata for easier debug. That means X-Route-PriceHint is ending up in billing_event.metadata and then the invoice transform has a mapping that falls back to metadata.price_hint for line pricing. 

jen: ah ok. that explains the preview delta. Some tenants had route variants with different hints and transform picked the higher one. UX issue for console — preview shows higher unit price but logs show routing chose cheaper variant.

rahul: proposal: two simultaneous fixes: (1) stop automatic header copy in enricher and whitelist only the fields we want; (2) explicitly ignore price_hint in invoice transform unless tenant opt-in.

taylor: +1. Also suggest adding test to metering unit tests that prevents header leakage. We had regressions before where debug headers became billing fields.

metering-bot: alert: invoice-preview-delta >= 2% for staging-tenant set (2026-03-23 09:14 UTC). Related thread: 1767733333.

jen: for rollout UX — we should surface a console flag when route-cost-signals are used in routing but not billed. Otherwise SREs will see preview mismatch and escalate. Maybe a small badge: "Routing hint used — not billed" on invoice preview.

rahul: good idea. Also need a gradual rollout: canary in proxy -> canary in enricher (stop copy) -> transform change. Order matters. If we change transform first, previews may flip mid-rollout.

eoin: I started a branch that adds a header whitelist to enricher: in lambda-ingest pipeline: 
```
# example
ALLOWED_DEBUG_HEADERS = ["X-Request-Id","X-Tenant-Source","X-User-Agent"]
# X-Route-PriceHint deliberately excluded
```
Will open PR tonight.

jen: can we include a console toggle to opt-in tenants to honor price_hint for billing? Some enterprise customers want route-level surcharges for premium models.

rahul: yes — model: per-tenant billing feature flag. Default false. When true, transform will map metadata.price_hint -> invoice.unit_price_override and emit audit row. Must go through contracts.

taylor: ops note: add telemetry to track how many events contain route_price_hint pre- and post-whitelist so we can confirm the cleanup. Also emit metric with tag transform_applied=true/false and why.

metering-bot: metric event: route_price_hint.count=3728 (staging) at 1767733400.

eoin: quick test results after local whitelist change: route_price_hint.count drops to ~120 (mainly from internal test clients). I'll push the canary tomorrow.

jen: UX follow-ups: add console tooltip on invoice preview explaining why preview may differ from live invoice: "Some routing signals are used for runtime decisions, not billing; check tenant billing features to opt-in."

rahul: timeline proposal: today - merge enricher whitelist in canary cluster; tomorrow - enable canary; day after - update invoice transform with opt-in guard + tests; then console UI next week. Rollback plan: revert whitelist if we see >0.5% delta to be safe.

taylor: sounds sensible. Please add a short runbook snippet in the PR description for oncall: how to check preview vs invoice and how to flip the opt-in.

jen: I'll draft the console copy and badge mockups in product. Tagging @rahul and @eoin for design review when ready.

rahul: thanks. I'll file the sequencing PRs and include telemetry hooks.

metering-bot: deploy status: enricher-canary deployed to staging cluster at 1767733550.
